title: Referrals and Authorizations Release Computation for Expired Facility Authorizations
content:
When an approved Skilled Nursing Facility Authorization or Inpatient Mental Health Authorization covered under TRICARE Select reaches the day after the last day of its validity span, it is closed as expired on that day and the days left on it are released under **Referrals and Authorizations**.

## Computation

- **Days left.** The days left are the units granted plus the units added by extensions, less the units used, all read from the authorization's unit history (its grant entries, its extension entries and its use entries).
- **Release.** The release is every day left, and is never fewer than zero.

## Worked example (hypothetical unit history)

| Unit history entry | Days |
|---|---|
| Grant on approval | 14 |
| First extension | 14 |
| Use entries, in total | 20 |

Days left: 14 plus 14, less 20, gives 8 days. The release is 8 days.

## Second example (hypothetical)

A grant of 7 days, no extension and 7 days used leaves 0 days; the release is 0.
